subject: Marcus directive: provide 25 GP skill tasks + coaching feedback loop
body: FP - Marcus directed me to request this from you now. Please send 25 concrete platform/ops skill-building tasks I can execute in MCM over the next few hours. Requirement from Marcus: you must provide coaching and feedback on each task as I complete it, with pass/fail and what to improve. I also need your preferred structure for submissions (evidence format, where to post, turnaround expectation). I will start immediately and keep queue non-empty.
